item.title: Contrastive Learning
item.description: Contrastive Learning Definition Contrastive learning is the training objective underneath essentially every modern embedding model.

item.title: Staged Judging
item.description: Staged Judging Definition Staged judging applies cascade architecture to relevance evaluation rather than to retrieval.

item.title: Statistical Significance in Search Evaluation
item.description: Statistical Significance in Search Evaluation Definition A ranking change moves your metric.

item.title: BRIGHT
item.description: BRIGHT Overview BRIGHT is a retrieval benchmark of 1,385 real-world queries where finding the relevant document requires reasoning, not surface similarity.

item.title: LoTTE
item.description: LoTTE Overview LoTTE (Long-Tail Topic-stratified Evaluation) is a retrieval benchmark introduced alongside ColBERTv2, built from StackExchange communities and deliberately stratified toward long-tail topics rather than the head-heavy distributions that dominate web-search corpora like MS MARCO.

item.title: MIRACL
item.description: MIRACL Overview MIRACL (Multilingual Information Retrieval Across a Continuum of Languages) is a multilingual retrieval benchmark covering 18 languages over Wikipedia corpora, with queries written and relevance judged by native speakers of each language.

item.title: MTEB
item.description: MTEB Overview MTEB (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark) is the aggregate benchmark and public leaderboard that the embedding model field competes on.

item.title: RTEB
item.description: RTEB Overview RTEB (Retrieval Embedding Benchmark) is a retrieval-focused benchmark announced in beta on 1 October 2025 by the MTEB maintainers, built to attack one specific problem: the generalization gap between leaderboard scores and real-world retrieval accuracy.

item.title: Embedding Models Compared
item.description: Embedding Models Compared Overview The embedding model is the single most consequential choice in a dense retrieval stack.
